title: LESSON ONE: Clogging Dance from Scratch - The Basics
channel: Andy Howard and the American Racket Cloggers

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is informative, methodical, and patient, breaking down each clogging step meticulously. He combines detailed physical demonstrations with helpful analogies to guide absolute beginners.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the clogging lesson from scratch
Combining double step and rock step into a basic

metaphors: imagine there's a wall behind you
common_mistakes: doing steps too big to speed up later
making sounds behind your body like a wall
safety: talk to your parents about what shoes and floor are allowed
avoid scratching tile or wood floors

steps_taught.name: double step
steps_taught.description: brush forward, brush backward, and step

what_works: clear angle changes showing front and back views
repeating counts and exercises multiple times
what_hinders: long explanations before getting to movement

quotes.text: I'm going to be teaching a beginner from scratch clogging lesson.
if you do the wrong shoes on the wrong floor you could skin up your tile floor
our first step is called a double step
imagine there's a wall behind you
a double step and a rock step together we call a single basic
